faqs.q: What is a GAF Master Elite contractor?
faqs.a: GAF Master Elite status places us among the top 2% of roofers nationwide. We're also one of only 127 contractors to earn 3-Star President's Club status with GAF in 2026 - rigorous standards for training, insurance, customer satisfaction, and warranty-qualified installation.
Yes - $0-down financing with flexible monthly payments. Most homeowners qualify, and we'll walk you through the options during your free estimate.

faqs.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
faqs.a: Most residential roof replacements are completed in 1-2 days. We'll confirm timing during your inspection and keep you updated throughout the project.

faqs.q: Do you help with insurance claims?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We work directly with your insurance company from inspection through final payment - our team documents the damage, meets with adjusters on-site, and handles the paperwork.
